These fixtures are real responses from a reserved Cisco DevNet Meraki sandbox,
recorded 2026-11-16 with `uv run python -m netops_agent.record tests/fixtures`.
Checked and scrubbed for secrets: no API keys, tokens, passwords, or PSKs are
present. The sandbox org is temporary; IDs and dashboard URLs no longer resolve
after the reservation ends.

File name = request path with "/" replaced by "_", plus "_<productType>" for
event queries.
